title: Accepted advisories
description: The advisories a repository accepts in the dependency audit: each one has no fix the repository can take, and does not affect the repository. Each entry carries the fields of a VEX not_affected statement, in VEX's names and justification values; its status, not_affected, is implied by its place in this file. The file is accepted-advisories.yaml at the repository root; absent, nothing is accepted.

vulnerability.description: The advisory's id as the audit reports it: a GHSA id, or the PYSEC or CVE id pip-audit names.

impact_statement.description: Why the repository is not affected: where the package is used, and what keeps the vulnerability from affecting it there.
